{{Short description|Family name}}
'''Shepherd''' is a [[surname]], [[cognate]] of the English word "[[Shepherd]]". Several common spelling variations exist, including '''Shepperd''', '''Sheperd''', '''Shephard''', '''Sheppard''', and '''Shepard'''.
